## Before you open a pull request

- [ ] I linked the issue this pull request addresses.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behavior I changed.
- [ ] I used `t()` for new interface text.
- [ ] My changes follow the Content Security Policy rules: no inline scripts or `style` attributes, and no `innerHTML` for provider or user content.
- [ ] I used the tokens in `public/editor-theme.css` instead of hard-coded colors, sizes, or icons.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:desktop` passes.
